categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen SEICHI Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on testing and inspection equipment and system solutions, primarily in semiconductor memory device testing and new display device detection. The company offers semiconductor memory testing solutions including wafer testing, aging testing and repair, packaging testing, and related accessories. It also provides new display device detection solutions for AMOLED, TFT-LCD, micro-displays, covering optical detection, calibration, aging systems, signal generators, and inspection accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies such as Algorithmic Pattern Generator (ALPG), DRAM repair algorithms, MEMS probe card design and manufacturing, high-precision timing signal generation, high-speed signal interconnection, automated PCB delay testing, uniform temperature control in aging chambers, Micro LED wafer lighting detection, and AI-based visual inspection platforms. It employs advanced manufacturing and assembly processes for MEMS probe cards and integrates software algorithms with hardware for precise electrical and optical testing. The production follows a make-to-order model with strict quality control from material procurement to system debugging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major semiconductor memory manufacturers like ChangXin Technology and PeiDun Technology, and leading new display device manufacturers such as BOE Technology, TCL Technology, Visionox, and Tianma Microelectronics. The company serves industries in semiconductor memory testing and new display device manufacturing, including emerging markets like AI glasses, AR/VR terminals, and micro-display technologies. Its products are used in DRAM, NAND Flash, AMOLED, Micro LED, and Micro OLED production lines.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant business in regions including South China, Central China, East China, North China, and Southwest China. It has expanded overseas markets, notably securing orders from key international AR/VR terminal manufacturers. The company also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and other Chinese cities such as Suzhou, Changsha, and Hefei to strengthen regional presence and localize customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen SEICHI Technologies operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and display device supply chain, providing testing and inspection equipment essential for quality control in semiconductor memory and new display device manufacturing processes. It supplies equipment and system solutions directly to manufacturers, enabling them to ensure product performance and yield before final packaging and shipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on advanced semiconductor testing technologies including DRAM high-speed testing, SoC testing machines, and advanced packaging testing equipment. It also emphasizes new display detection technologies for AMOLED, Micro LED, and Micro OLED, integrating AI for defect detection and classification. Strategic initiatives include expanding product lines, enhancing system-level solutions, and strengthening intellectual property protection with a growing R&D team and patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of testing and inspection equipment and related accessories to semiconductor and display device manufacturers. Additional income comes from equipment maintenance and service contracts. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging customers through commercial negotiations and bidding processes, with a focus on long-term partnerships and system solution offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major international semiconductor testing equipment providers such as Advantest and Teradyne, especially in DRAM testing equipment markets. It is one of the few domestic companies with a comprehensive product line covering all major semiconductor memory testing stages and has achieved significant domestic market penetration and initial overseas breakthroughs. In new display device detection, it holds a leading position in China with growing market share and technological advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 803 million, a 23.83% increase year-over-year, driven by a nearly 200% growth in semiconductor business revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 80.16 million, a 30.71% decrease due to increased R&D investment and margin pressures during growth. Total assets reached RMB 2.03 billion with net assets of RMB 1.72 billion, reflecting steady financial health and ongoing expansion. R&D expenses increased by 52.66%, accounting for 13.66% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing high-quality, innovative testing and inspection equipment with strong technological autonomy and comprehensive system solutions. It differentiates through advanced proprietary technologies, extensive product coverage across semiconductor memory and new display device testing stages, and strong customer recognition. Its local service capabilities, rapid response, and integration of AI for intelligent defect detection further enhance its competitive edge, supporting domestic substitution of imported equipment and meeting evolving market demands.
